metric: Exact entity-level micro P/R/F1 on identical sample IDs and four news labels.

GLiNER.label: GLiNER
GLiNER.selection_source: Fixed delivered zero-shot configuration and threshold

protocol.familiarity: Whole casefolded entity token sequence in any CoNLL-2003 training gold entity, irrespective of its type. False positives use their predicted name.
protocol.familiarity_limit: Seen/unseen uses one common CoNLL-2003 labelled-training reference, not each method's actual exposure, its pretraining corpus or world knowledge. LoRA used only 10% of that training split.
protocol.classic_predictions: Reconstructed locally using the official main code and selected parameters. This report scores the supplied answers directly; small M1 numerical differences from a previous machine's aggregate CSV are resolved by the reconstructed answers.
protocol.checksum: Both actual-byte and LF-normalized SHA-256 values are recorded. B's manifest checks accept exact bytes or CRLF-to-LF normalization only.
protocol.neural_seed: Seed 0 selected in advance for every single-answer comparison; training configurations were selected on validation data by B.
protocol.llm: Qwen2.5-7B, 10 similar retrieved training examples, no guideline; selected using C's fixed validation-300 results.
protocol.ensemble: The four member groups were fixed before scoring; all groups are reported, with strict typed-span majority.
protocol.ensemble_reference: Difference from the group's best observed constituent; bootstrap interval holds that reference fixed and does not account for selecting it.
protocol.temporal: All methods use the same 300 fixed IDs per corpus because C supplies CoNLL++ only at this scope.
protocol.coverage: All ten methods participate in familiarity, paired replacement, full-test perturbations, fixed-300 temporal scoring and error overlap.
protocol.replacement_original: Use the separately delivered paired-original answers for all methods. The new LoRA paired original differs from its earlier full-original output on two sentences; changed IDs are recorded without attributing an unverified cause.
